_scope_note: Candidate only. Review and deploy by hand; never applied automatically. Keeps the built-in rule lists via $defaults.

environment: Source of truth: GitHub repositories owned by the owner; Jira for tickets; the workstation profile is corporate.
Task-owned resources (own worktree, scratch dir, regenerable build output) may be created and removed; other sessions' work is not task-owned.
Routine merges follow the repository's documented PR class policy; a host denial stands and is reported, never rerouted.
Corporate machine: data leaves only to destinations inside the formally approved corporate trust boundary.
